print_run.label: Print run
print_run.description: The same card from another print run, told apart by an edition stamp, a shadow or a copyright line.

parallel.label: Parallel
parallel.description: Other finishes beside the standard copy, with nothing else of their own. With it, these make the master set.

serial_code.label: Serial-code variant
serial_code.tell: The same physical version with another serial code printed at the bottom. The code does not establish a chronological print run.
serial_code.description: The same physical version with another serial code printed at the bottom. The code does not establish a chronological print run.

special.label: Special release
special.description: Copies with a stamp, material or way of being handed out of their own: event and League stamps, deck- and box-only foils.

test.label: Test print
test.description: Never sold. Cut from test sheets that left the printer.

non_holo.label: Non-holo
non_holo.tell: No foil anywhere on the card.

holo.label: Holo
holo.tell: The picture shines; the rest of the card doesn't.

poke_ball.label: Poké Ball pattern
poke_ball.tell: Reverse foil with Poké Balls worked into it, in rows or one large ball below the picture.

master_ball.label: Master Ball pattern
master_ball.tell: Reverse foil with Master Balls worked into it, the rarer twin of the Poké Ball pattern.

energy_symbol.label: Energy symbol pattern
energy_symbol.tell: Reverse foil with the card's Energy symbol worked into it, behind the Pokémon or large below the picture.

cosmos_holo.label: Cosmos holo
cosmos_holo.tell: Holo foil of dots and circles of different sizes, like a night sky.

mirror_holo.label: Mirror holo
mirror_holo.tell: Foil with no pattern: a plain, mirror-like silver shine without the rainbow of holo foil.

pixel_cosmos_holo.label: Pixel cosmos holo
pixel_cosmos_holo.tell: Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

crosshatch_holo.label: Crosshatch holo
crosshatch_holo.tell: Foil of crossing diagonal lines, a shiny grid, usually everywhere but the picture.

confetti_holo.label: Confetti holo
confetti_holo.tell: Holo foil of small blocky flecks, like confetti.

tinsel_holo.label: Tinsel holo
tinsel_holo.tell: Holo foil of fine horizontal stripes.

glossy.label: Glossy
glossy.tell: No foil, but a glossy coat that looks a little shiny when held to the light.

cracked_ice_holo.label: Cracked ice holo
cracked_ice_holo.tell: Foil broken into irregular shards, like cracked ice or shattered glass.

stars.label: Stars
stars.tell: Reverse foil scattered with small five-pointed stars.

rotary.label: Rotary holo
rotary.tell: Reverse foil in a geometric pinwheel pattern across the whole card.

vertical_line_holo.label: Vertical line holo
vertical_line_holo.tell: Holo foil of thin vertical lines across the picture.

reverse_cosmos_holo.label: Reverse cosmos holo
reverse_cosmos_holo.tell: Cosmos foil, dots and circles, everywhere but the picture.

dusk_ball.label: Dusk Ball pattern
dusk_ball.tell: Reverse foil with one large Dusk Ball below the picture.

sheen_holo.label: Sheen holo
sheen_holo.tell: Holo foil with no pattern whose shine sweeps diagonally across the picture.

love_ball.label: Love Ball pattern
love_ball.tell: Reverse foil with one large Love Ball below the picture.

friend_ball.label: Friend Ball pattern
friend_ball.tell: Reverse foil with one large Friend Ball below the picture.

quick_ball.label: Quick Ball pattern
quick_ball.tell: Reverse foil with one large Quick Ball below the picture.

team_rocket_logo_mirror_holo.label: Team Rocket logo mirror holo
team_rocket_logo_mirror_holo.tell: Reverse foil with a large Team Rocket "R" below the picture, on Team Rocket's Pokémon.

reverse_tinsel_holo.label: Reverse tinsel holo
reverse_tinsel_holo.tell: Tinsel foil, fine horizontal stripes, everywhere but the picture.

confetti_reverse_holo.label: Confetti reverse holo
confetti_reverse_holo.tell: Confetti foil, small blocky flecks, everywhere but the picture.

mirage_holo.label: Mirage holo
mirage_holo.tell: Holo foil with no pattern whose shine runs side to side, unlike sheen holo's diagonal.

water_web_holo.label: Water web holo
water_web_holo.tell: Holo foil of wavy lines, like rippling water.

sequin_holo.label: Sequin holo
sequin_holo.tell: Holo foil of many small geometric flecks, like sequins.

disco_holo.label: Disco holo
disco_holo.tell: Holo foil of small, tightly packed round dots, a pattern no released card uses: Base Set test prints only.

lenticular.label: Lenticular
lenticular.tell: The picture moves or changes as the card tilts, under a ridged plastic face.

speckle_holo.label: Speckle holo
speckle_holo.tell: Fine specks of foil, like powder, across the whole front of the card.

vertical_line_reverse_holo.label: Vertical line reverse holo
vertical_line_reverse_holo.tell: Foil of thin vertical lines everywhere but the picture.

starlight_holo.label: Starlight holo
starlight_holo.tell: Holo foil scattered with stars and starbursts of different sizes.

magic_foil.label: Magic foil
magic_foil.tell: Plain foil over the whole card, on Magic: The Gathering card stock: Blastoise test prints only.

first_edition.label: 1st Edition
first_edition.tell: A 1st Edition symbol, usually on the other side of the card from the set symbol (beside it on early Japanese 1st Editions).

unlimited.label: Unlimited
unlimited.tell: No 1st Edition symbol: a later print run.

no_rarity.label: No rarity symbol
no_rarity.tell: No rarity mark where the card would have one.

shadowless.label: Shadowless
shadowless.tell: No drop shadow around the picture, thin HP and attack text, and no 1st Edition symbol; Trainers and Energy read "© 1995, 96, 98, 99 Nintendo".

4th_print.label: 4th print
4th_print.tell: Like the Unlimited print, drop shadow and all, but the copyright line ends "©1999-2000 Wizards" instead of "©1999 Wizards".

no_e_reader.label: No e-Reader strip
no_e_reader.tell: No e-Reader dot code along the card's edge.

fossil_1999_2000_print.label: 1999-2000 print
fossil_1999_2000_print.tell: A non-holo whose copyright line ends "©1999-2000 Wizards", from Australia's red-logo Fossil packs.

first_edition_no_rarity.label: 1st Edition, no rarity symbol
first_edition_no_rarity.tell: A 1st Edition symbol but no rarity mark.

white_border_test_print.label: White-border test print
white_border_test_print.tell: A white border where the released card's is yellow.

for_position_only_test_print.label: "For Position Only" test print
for_position_only_test_print.tell: "For Position Only" in white letters across the picture, and "Medium" in small black type at the lower left.

hole_punched_glossy_back_test_print.label: Hole punched glossy back test print

hole_punched_matte_back_test_print.label: Hole punched matte back test print

black_border_test_print.label: Black-border test print
black_border_test_print.tell: A black border, in plain foil on Magic: The Gathering card stock; the one known copy is still on its test sheet.

first_edition_shadowed.label: 1st Edition (shadowed)
first_edition_shadowed.tell: A 1st Edition symbol on the later Base Set design, with a drop shadow around the picture and thicker HP and attack text. Only Base Set's Machamp: the 2-Player Starter Sets printed after the shadowless run kept its stamp.

gold_border_test_print.label: Gold-border test print
gold_border_test_print.tell: A gold border, on Magic: The Gathering card stock with a Magic back.

manji_print.label: Manji print
manji_print.tell: A red manji (卍) at the upper left of the picture, where later prints have a round red emblem.

tane_text_print.label: たね spelled out
tane_text_print.tell: The first attack's text spells out たね (Basic) where the other print shows the Basic Pokémon mark.

30th_anniversary_stamp.label: 30th anniversary stamp
30th_anniversary_stamp.tell: The 30th anniversary logo on the card.

play_pokemon_stamp.label: Play! Pokémon stamp
play_pokemon_stamp.tell: The Play! Pokémon logo stamped on the card, usually at the bottom right of the picture.

25th_anniversary_stamp.label: 25th anniversary stamp
25th_anniversary_stamp.tell: The 25th anniversary logo on the card.

prerelease.label: Prerelease stamp
prerelease.tell: A foil "PRERELEASE" stamp, or from HeartGold & SoulSilver on the expansion's logo, at the bottom right of the picture.

gym_stamp.label: Pokémon TCG Gym stamp
gym_stamp.tell: The Pokémon TCG Gym logo stamped on the picture, on promos given out at events of certified gym shops.

pikachu_silhouette_stamp.label: Pikachu silhouette
pikachu_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Pikachu silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Pikachu deck in a box of ready-made decks.

staff_prerelease.label: Staff Prerelease stamp
staff_prerelease.tell: The Prerelease stamp plus the word "STAFF", for the people who ran the Prerelease events.

gem_pack_stamp.label: Gem Pack stamp
gem_pack_stamp.tell: The Gem Pack logo stamped on the picture.

league.label: Pokémon League stamp
league.tell: The Pokémon League logo stamped on the card, usually on the picture.

world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships stamp
world_championships_stamp.tell: A World Championships stamp on the picture: "Worlds" and the year on early cards, the World Championships logo and year on later ones.

greninja_silhouette_stamp.label: Greninja silhouette
greninja_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Greninja silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Greninja deck in a box of ready-made decks.

lucario_silhouette_stamp.label: Lucario silhouette
lucario_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Lucario silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Lucario deck in a box of ready-made decks.

sprigatito_silhouette_stamp.label: Sprigatito silhouette
sprigatito_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Sprigatito silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Sprigatito deck in a box of ready-made decks.

pikachu_jack_o_lantern_stamp.label: Pikachu jack-o'-lantern stamp
pikachu_jack_o_lantern_stamp.tell: A Pikachu jack-o'-lantern stamped at the bottom right of the picture.

professor_program_stamp.label: Professor Program stamp
professor_program_stamp.tell: The Professor Program logo, the word "Professor" with a Poké Ball, stamped on the card, for Pokémon Professors.

snowflake_stamp.label: Snowflake stamp
snowflake_stamp.tell: A gold or silver foil snowflake stamped on the picture, on holiday calendar cards.

cinderace_silhouette_stamp.label: Cinderace silhouette
cinderace_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Cinderace silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Cinderace deck in a box of ready-made decks.

oshawott_silhouette_stamp.label: Oshawott silhouette
oshawott_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Oshawott silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Oshawott deck in a box of ready-made decks.

volkswagen_id3_stamp.label: Volkswagen ID.3 stamp
volkswagen_id3_stamp.tell: The ID.3 car mark at the lower right of the picture, from the 2023 SAIC Volkswagen tie-in in China.

korean_league_stamp.label: Korean League stamp
korean_league_stamp.tell: A "KOREAN LEAGUE" logo printed on the card (Korean promos).

regional_championships_stamp.label: Regional Championships stamp
regional_championships_stamp.tell: The Regional Championships logo stamped on the picture.

staff_regional_championships_stamp.label: Staff Regional Championships stamp
staff_regional_championships_stamp.tell: The Regional Championships logo plus the word "STAFF".

miraidon_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Miraidon silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Miraidon deck in a box of ready-made decks.

zamazenta_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Zamazenta silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Zamazenta deck in a box of ready-made decks.

gimmighoul_silhouette_stamp.label: Gimmighoul silhouette

mabosstiff_silhouette_stamp.label: Mabosstiff silhouette
mabosstiff_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Mabosstiff silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Mabosstiff deck in a box of ready-made decks.

winner_stamp.label: Winner stamp
winner_stamp.tell: A foil "winner" stamp on the picture: lowercase with a star on Wizards of the Coast cards, "WINNER" beside a Poké Ball on later ones.

clefairy_silhouette_stamp.label: Clefairy silhouette
clefairy_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Clefairy silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Clefairy deck in a box of ready-made decks.

koraidon_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Koraidon silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Koraidon deck in a box of ready-made decks.

decidueye_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Decidueye silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Decidueye deck in a box of ready-made decks.

infernape_silhouette_stamp.label: Infernape silhouette
infernape_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Infernape silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Infernape deck in a box of ready-made decks.

mewtwo_silhouette_stamp.label: Mewtwo silhouette
mewtwo_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Mewtwo silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Mewtwo deck in a box of ready-made decks.

event_organizer_logo.label: Event Organizer logo
event_organizer_logo.tell: A round dark red "EVENT ORGANIZER" emblem printed on the picture, on promos from the packs Japan's endorsed independent event organizers handed out.

pokemon_center_stamp.label: Pokémon Center stamp
pokemon_center_stamp.tell: The Pokémon Center logo stamped on the card, from the Pokémon Center editions of products.

extra_battle_day_stamp.label: Extra Battle Day stamp
extra_battle_day_stamp.tell: An "エクストラバトルの日" (Extra Battle Day) logo printed on the picture.

1st_place_league_challenge_stamp.label: League Challenge 1st Place stamp
1st_place_league_challenge_stamp.tell: The Pokémon League logo with "1st Place" stamped on the picture, the League Challenge prize for first place.

2nd_place_league_challenge_stamp.label: League Challenge 2nd Place stamp
2nd_place_league_challenge_stamp.tell: The Pokémon League logo with "2nd Place" stamped on the picture, the League Challenge prize for second place.

3rd_place_league_challenge_stamp.label: League Challenge 3rd Place stamp
3rd_place_league_challenge_stamp.tell: The Pokémon League logo with "3rd Place" stamped on the picture, the League Challenge prize for third place.

4th_place_league_challenge_stamp.label: League Challenge 4th Place stamp
4th_place_league_challenge_stamp.tell: The Pokémon League logo with "4th Place" stamped on the picture, the League Challenge prize for fourth place.

victini_bwr_battle_stamp.label: Victini BWR battle stamp
victini_bwr_battle_stamp.tell: A Victini BWR battle logo printed on the card: "비크티니BWR 쟁탈전" on Korean promos, "ビクティニBWR争奪戦" on Japanese ones.

gamestop_stamp.label: GameStop stamp
gamestop_stamp.tell: The GameStop logo stamped at the bottom right of the picture, a gift with purchase.

sealed_battle_stamp.label: Sealed battle stamp
sealed_battle_stamp.tell: A Sealed Battle mark printed on the card: "실드전" on Korean promos, "シールド戦" on Japanese ones.

charizard_silhouette_stamp.label: Charizard silhouette
charizard_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Charizard silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Charizard deck in a box of ready-made decks.

raichu_silhouette_stamp.label: Raichu silhouette
raichu_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Raichu silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Raichu deck in a box of ready-made decks.

ebgames_stamp.label: EB Games stamp
ebgames_stamp.tell: The EB Games logo stamped at the bottom right of the picture, a gift with purchase in Australia and New Zealand.

darkrai_silhouette_stamp.label: Darkrai silhouette
darkrai_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Darkrai silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Darkrai deck in a box of ready-made decks.

froakie_silhouette_stamp.label: Froakie silhouette
froakie_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Froakie silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Froakie deck in a box of ready-made decks.

eevee_silhouette_stamp.label: Eevee silhouette
eevee_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Eevee silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Eevee deck in a box of ready-made decks.

finalist_world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships Finalist stamp
finalist_world_championships_stamp.tell: "FINALIST" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

quarter_finalist_world_championships_sta.label: World Championships Quarter-Finalist stamp
quarter_finalist_world_championships_sta.tell: "QUARTER-FINALIST" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

semi_finalist_world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships Semi-Finalist stamp
semi_finalist_world_championships_stamp.tell: "SEMI-FINALIST" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

staff_world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships Staff stamp
staff_world_championships_stamp.tell: "STAFF" printed on the card, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: for the people who ran the event.

top_sixteen_world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships Top Sixteen stamp
top_sixteen_world_championships_stamp.tell: "TOP SIXTEEN" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

top_thirty_two_world_championships_stamp.label: World Championships Top Thirty-Two stamp
top_thirty_two_world_championships_stamp.tell: "TOP THIRTY-TWO" printed below the card text, with the World Championships stamp on the picture: a prize for that placing.

emboar_silhouette_stamp.label: Emboar silhouette
emboar_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Emboar silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Emboar deck in a box of ready-made decks.

mini_league_stamp.label: Mini League stamp
mini_league_stamp.tell: A "POKÉMON MINI LEAGUE" badge printed on the card (Korean promos).

prismatic_evolutions_stamp.label: Prismatic Evolutions stamp
prismatic_evolutions_stamp.tell: The Prismatic Evolutions logo stamped on the picture.

snivy_silhouette_stamp.label: Snivy silhouette
snivy_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Snivy silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Snivy deck in a box of ready-made decks.

tepig_silhouette_stamp.label: Tepig silhouette
tepig_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Tepig silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Tepig deck in a box of ready-made decks.

thundurus_silhouette_stamp.label: Thundurus silhouette
thundurus_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Thundurus silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Thundurus deck in a box of ready-made decks.

togekiss_silhouette_stamp.label: Togekiss silhouette
togekiss_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Togekiss silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Togekiss deck in a box of ready-made decks.

tornadus_silhouette_stamp.label: Tornadus silhouette
tornadus_silhouette_stamp.tell: A small coloured Tornadus silhouette at the bottom right of the card: the mark of the Tornadus deck in a box of ready-made decks.

toys_r_us_stamp.label: Toys "R" Us stamp
toys_r_us_stamp.tell: The Toys "R" Us logo stamped at the bottom right of the picture.

build_a_bear_workshop_stamp.label: Build-A-Bear Workshop stamp
build_a_bear_workshop_stamp.tell: The Build-A-Bear Workshop logo stamped on the picture.

gold_mini_league_stamp.label: Gold mini league stamp
gold_mini_league_stamp.tell: A gold "POKÉMON MINI LEAGUE" badge printed on the card (Korean promos).

league_cup_stamp.label: League Cup stamp
league_cup_stamp.tell: The League Cup logo stamped on the picture.

staff_league_cup_stamp.label: Staff League Cup stamp
staff_league_cup_stamp.tell: The League Cup logo plus the word "STAFF".

city_championships_stamp.label: City Championships stamp
city_championships_stamp.tell: The City Championships logo stamped on the picture.

league_judge_stamp.label: League judge stamp
league_judge_stamp.tell: The word JUDGE printed under a Premier Ball, Ultra Ball or Master Ball League logo, on copies for the league's judges.

national_championships_stamp.label: National Championships stamp
national_championships_stamp.tell: The National Championships logo stamped on the picture.

state_championships_stamp.label: State Championships stamp
state_championships_stamp.tell: The State, Province and Territory Championships logo stamped on the picture.

trainer_deck_b_stamp.label: Trainer Deck B back
trainer_deck_b_stamp.tell: "Trainer Deck B" printed on the back, which has a red border. The fronts match Base Set except Blastoise's, which is non-holo.

diamond_pearl_stamp.label: Diamond & Pearl logo stamp
diamond_pearl_stamp.tell: The Diamond & Pearl logo stamped at the bottom right of the picture, on Burger King cards of 2008.

platinum_stamp.label: Platinum logo stamp
platinum_stamp.tell: The Platinum logo stamped at the bottom right of the picture, on Burger King cards of 2009.

staff_national_championships_stamp.label: Staff National Championships stamp
staff_national_championships_stamp.tell: The National Championships logo plus the word "STAFF".

stellar_crown_stamp.label: Stellar Crown stamp
stellar_crown_stamp.tell: The Stellar Crown logo stamped on the picture.

trainer_deck_a_stamp.label: Trainer Deck A back
trainer_deck_a_stamp.tell: "Trainer Deck A" printed on the back, which has a red border. The fronts match Base Set except Machamp's, which is non-holo and has no 1st Edition symbol.

guangzhou_master_tournament_stamp.label: Guangzhou Master Tournament stamp

incorrect_height.label: Wrong height
incorrect_height.tell: The height in the Pokédex line under the picture is wrong, where other prints of the card have it right.

no_set_symbol.label: No set symbol
no_set_symbol.tell: No set symbol at the lower right of the picture, where later prints of the card have one.

texture_error.label: Texture error
texture_error.tell: Printed with the surface texture meant for another print: the Traditional Chinese print's on MEGA Dream ex cards, which leaves untextured patches around the Pokémon's name and attack text, or the special art rare's on the gold N's Zoroark ex.

dp25_card_number_error.label: DP25 number error
dp25_card_number_error.tell: Numbered DP25, the number of the 2008 card, instead of DP48.

energy_symbol_error.label: Energy symbol error
energy_symbol_error.tell: The wrong Energy symbol in an attack cost or the card's text, such as Fighting where Blaine's Charizard's Roaring Flames should cost Fire.

inverted_stamp.label: Upside-down stamp
inverted_stamp.tell: The stamp is upside down, in the opposite corner of the picture.

missing_stamp_error.label: Missing stamp
missing_stamp_error.tell: No stamp where the card's other English copies have one, such as the gold "Pokémon The First Movie" stamp.

redacted_print.label: Redacted print
redacted_print.tell: An early jumbo with blanks where its type, attack costs, weakness, resistance and retreat cost should be.

aoki_illustrator_credit_error.label: Toshinao Aoki credit error
aoki_illustrator_credit_error.tell: "Illus. Toshinao Aoki" at the lower left, though Naoyo Kimura drew the card.

double_holo_error.label: Double holo
double_holo_error.tell: The foil fills the faint white outline around the Pokémon that ordinary copies show.

uncommon_rarity_error.label: Uncommon rarity error
uncommon_rarity_error.tell: An Uncommon diamond beside the number of a card that is Common, with a circle on corrected prints.

upside_down_back_error.label: Upside-down back
upside_down_back_error.tell: The back is printed upside down against the front.

artwork_error.label: Artwork error
artwork_error.tell: The picture differs from the corrected print's: Chandelure VMAX's first Japanese print has a full line round Chandelure's head, not just between its eyes.

blue_ink_dot_error.label: Blue ink dot
blue_ink_dot_error.tell: A spot of blue ink on Vulpix's hindquarters.

cigar_stain_error.label: Cigar stain
cigar_stain_error.tell: A vertical stain of gold border ink down the left side of the card.

damage_counters_text_error.label: Damage counters left out
damage_counters_text_error.tell: The text leaves out how many damage counters to put on a Pokémon.

evolution_box_error.label: Evolution box error
evolution_box_error.tell: The evolution box at the top left is wrong: it shows the card's own Pokémon, or a blank patch sits where a box would be on a Pokémon that doesn't evolve.

highlighter_error.label: Highlighter error
highlighter_error.tell: A streak where the magenta ink did not print, as if the picture had been marked with a yellow highlighter.

missing_attack_damage.label: Missing attack damage
missing_attack_damage.tell: An attack with no damage number beside it.

no_hp_error.label: No HP
no_hp_error.tell: No HP printed at the top right.

non_holo_error.label: Non-holo with the holo number
non_holo_error.tell: A non-holo printed with the holo card's number, such as a Dark Dragonite numbered 5/82 instead of 22/82.

pokedex_entry_error.label: Pokédex entry error
pokedex_entry_error.tell: Another Pokémon's Pokédex entry at the bottom of the card, such as Hoppip with Skiploom's.

red_cheeks.label: Red cheeks
red_cheeks.tell: Pikachu's cheeks are red, not yellow.

red_ink_dot_error.label: Red ink dot
red_ink_dot_error.tell: A small red ink dot or diamond in the attack text, such as Blastoise's above Hydro Pump's Energy cost.

undaunted_expansion_symbol_error.label: Undaunted symbol error
undaunted_expansion_symbol_error.tell: The Undaunted set symbol where HeartGold & SoulSilver's should be.

2012_copyright_error.label: ©2012 error
2012_copyright_error.tell: The copyright line reads ©2012 where other prints read ©2013.

black_flame.label: Black flame
black_flame.tell: Ninetales's right-hand flame is black, as on the 1st Edition and Shadowless prints; most unlimited copies show it blue.

black_ink_dot_error.label: Black ink blot
black_ink_dot_error.tell: A large black ink blot in the attack text, such as Clefairy's over the "no" of "now Asleep".

blue_flame_error.label: Blue flame
blue_flame_error.tell: A large blue patch beside Magmar's tail that makes the flame look blue.

blue_ink_smear_error.label: Blue ink stain
blue_ink_smear_error.tell: A blue ink stain at the lower right of the picture.

corrected_resistance.label: Corrected resistance
corrected_resistance.tell: The corrected print, with the resistance the card should have: Fighting, on Clair's Mantine.

d_edition_error.label: "D Edition" error
d_edition_error.tell: An ink spot turns the "1" of the 1st Edition symbol into a "d".

d_efending_error.label: "D.efending" error
d_efending_error.tell: A stray period in the attack text, which reads "D.efending Pokémon".

d_ink_dot_error.label: Black dot on the "d"
d_ink_dot_error.tell: A black ink dot on the "d" of the Pokémon's name.

don_t_error.label: "Don t" error
don_t_error.tell: The text reads "Don t", with a gap where the apostrophe should be.

first_edition_error.label: 1st Edition symbol error
first_edition_error.tell: A 1st Edition symbol on a promo that should have none.

ghost_stamp_error.label: Ghost stamp
ghost_stamp_error.tell: Only a faint outline of the 1st Edition symbol, missing the "1st" and the "d" of "Edition".

gray_background_error.label: Gray background
gray_background_error.tell: A gray background behind the Pokémon where later prints have black.

heart_stamp_error.label: Red heart
heart_stamp_error.tell: A small pink heart-shaped ink mark above the picture.

incomplete_expansion_symbol_error.label: Broken set symbol
incomplete_expansion_symbol_error.tell: A slash-like gap in the set symbol.

incorrect_card_attacks.label: Wrong attacks
incorrect_card_attacks.tell: Printed with another card's attacks, such as the Japanese Victini V promo with a different Victini V's.

ken_sugimori_illustrator_error.label: Ken Sugimori credit error
ken_sugimori_illustrator_error.tell: The art is credited to Ken Sugimori; later prints name Keiji Kinebuchi.

misaligned_energy_text.label: Misaligned Energy banner
misaligned_energy_text.tell: The top banner sits too high, with no space above the Energy symbol and "ENERGY".

missing_star_pattern.label: No star pattern
missing_star_pattern.tell: Holo foil without its star pattern, from the Dragapult ex League Battle Deck.

poke_body_error.label: Poké-Body error
poke_body_error.tell: A Poké-Body symbol on what is a Poké-Power.

psychic_resistance_error.label: Psychic resistance error
psychic_resistance_error.tell: A Psychic resistance where the card should resist Fighting.

rotated_energy_symbol_error.label: Rotated Energy symbol
rotated_energy_symbol_error.tell: An Energy symbol in an attack cost turned 90 degrees.

scratch_error.label: Scratch error
scratch_error.tell: Scratch-like streaks where the foil shows through the ink.

shifted_energy_cost_error.label: Shifted Energy cost
shifted_energy_cost_error.tell: Energy cost symbols printed out of place, on a misaligned print layer.

stage_error.label: Missing "Stage"
stage_error.tell: The word "Stage" is missing from the evolution line at the top right, leaving a blank in "Put … on the ___ 1 card".

t_ink_dot_error.label: Black dot on the "t"
t_ink_dot_error.tell: A small black ink dot over the "t" of "Nintendo" in the copyright line.

white_circle_error.label: White circle error
white_circle_error.tell: A plain white circle where an attack cost should show an Energy symbol.

rare.label: Rare
rare.tell: A rare mark, with no holo or more of its own.

holo.label: Holo
holo.tell: Holo rares and their like: Holo Rare, the Japanese Rare (R), Prism Rare, Pikachu Rare.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.tell: Ultra rares: Ultra Rare, Double Rare, Triple Rare (RRR), Super Rare (SR), LEGEND, ACE SPEC, Radiant, Amazing, Shining and Shiny Rares, Character and Trainer Rares.

chase.label: Chase
chase.tell: Full-art illustrations and shiny full arts: Illustration and Art Rares, Mega Attack Rares, CSR, SSR, Shiny Ultra Rare, the Gem Pack Triple Rare, Classic Collection.

top_chase.label: Top chase
top_chase.tell: A set's top cards: Special Illustration and Special Art Rares, Hyper Rares and the Secret and Rainbow Rares before them, the Japanese Ultra Rare (UR), Gold Star, Black White, Futuristic and RGB Rares.
